title: Compress independent buffers and reuse codec state
goal: Encode and decode Deflate, ZLib and GZip buffers with status checks, bounded destinations and Reset between independent messages.

selectionNotes: Encode and decode Deflate, ZLib and GZip buffers with status checks, bounded destinations and Reset between independent messages. Desktop/server examples; inspect complete constraints before use.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This edition uses or relies on .NET 11 framework APIs/behaviour; .NET 10 is comparison-only.

prerequisites: Use a net11.0 console project with LangVersion=15.0, implicit usings and the namespaces stated in the complete recipe. No additional package, workload, account or provider is required.
constraints: Deflate is raw framing, ZLib adds its wrapper/checksum, and GZip has different headers/trailers; select the agreed wire format at both ends. Reset discards previous state and does not finish a pending frame: finalise and consume it first. Dispose all codec instances and avoid concurrent use. These complete finite-message helpers reject any status other than Done; they are not an incremental network parser. For incremental callers retain unconsumed input, advance only by bytesConsumed/bytesWritten, provide more output on DestinationTooSmall, provide new input on NeedMoreData, reject InvalidData, and mark isFinalBlock only at the actual end. Never spin on unchanged buffers. Bound compressed input and expanded output for untrusted peers; GetMaxCompressedLength is a compression allocation bound, not a safe decompression-size hint. Decoding into a known size here is for original trusted test messages, not arbitrary size metadata from an attacker.
stabilityLimitations: Verified with SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105; RC2 execution is not GA verification.

evidence.scope: Actual .NET 10 Windows compilation/execution: fresh Deflate/ZLib/GZip stream round trips and no-write empty-output baseline. Built-in Zstandard is explicitly unavailable and its stub is tested. No mocks, cross-compilation or GA proof.

Actual .NET 10 stream and RC2 span implementations round-trip empty, short, repetitive 8192-byte and subsequent independent payloads in all three formats. GZip checks additionally observe DestinationTooSmall for encode/decode and NeedMoreData for a partial header. Actual Windows compilation/execution; no mocks, cross-compilation or GA proof.

humanProof.scope: Bounded desktop/server archive and codec checks run locally without external providers or UI. No extra native/device or external-tool interoperability claim.
